title: Where do we draw the line?
text:
Note



This is an abstract for a paper submitted to the 13th annual gathering of the Implementing New Knowledge Environments (INKE) Partnership, whose theme this year is “Re-Defining Open Social Scholarship in an Age of Generative ‘Intelligence’”. The workshop will be hosted at Université de Montréal on June 4-5, 2026, coinciding with the annual conference of the Canadian Society for Digital Humanities and the Digital Humanities Summer Institute. The full paper and slides will be accessible here in the future.
